BiblicalUsage: Song of Solomon 2:9 is the word's only appearance, a single quiet picture: the beloved stands behind the wall of the house, looking in through the windows and the lattice. The wall is simply the wall of a home, doing what walls do, standing between the lover outside and the one he longs to see.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is simply that even a passing detail like this matters, because the Song treats ordinary things — a wall, a window — as part of a love story, and God gave us that picture on purpose.
